'''Gas Vortex''' was a [[Mining/Legends|mining]] colony located in the clouds of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Yhifar]]. Living in the station was extremely uncomfortable due to the immense pressure generated by the surrounding [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]].
